Blank Banshee 0 cover art

A low-polygon 3D head floating in a purple-to-cyan gradient under a wide italic title.

Source
Blank Banshee on Bandcamp
Creator
Blank Banshee
Made
September 1, 2012 (Bandcamp release date)
Style
Vaporwave (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Cool, uncanny, digital
Evidence
Inspected the 1200 × 1200 cover on the album’s Bandcamp page, in a scratchpad copy. Not stored.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Wikipedia: “In September [2012], Blank Banshee released his debut album, Blank Banshee 0,” which Bandwagon called a “progressive record” that, along with Floral Shoppe, “reconfigured what it means to make vaporwave music.” Wikipedia: Vaporwave.

Observed

  • The background is a vertical gradient from violet at the top to bright cyan at the bottom, with no texture.
  • A flat-shaded, low-polygon female head with angular brows and pink lips floats in the centre, cut off at the neck.
  • BLANK BANSHEE runs across the top in white, heavy, extended italic capitals with an A that has no crossbar.

Why it belongs

The most economical statement of the style: one dated 3D object and one gradient. The head reads like a late-1990s console character model.

Borrow

Use a single two-stop violet-to-cyan gradient behind one untextured 3D object, with no other decoration.
